subject.title: fix(logging): narrow STRUCTURED_APP_PASSWORD_FIELD_RE to Apple/iCloud-specific fields

question: Should generic text/error/detail fields redact app-password-shaped values only when Apple/iCloud/app-password context is present, or should OpenClaw require a stricter fail-closed, dictionary, or per-token proximity design before merge?
rationale: This patch intentionally reduces generic-field app-password masking to avoid content corruption, but that changes the credential-masking boundary for persisted logs and transcripts.

options.title: Accept Context-Gated Generic Redaction
options.body: After fixing the stale transcript test and adding live proof, merge this focused approach and accept that no-context generic app-password-shaped values may remain visible to preserve ordinary kebab identifiers.

options.title: Require Per-Token Or Proximity Context
options.body: Ask for a tighter token-near-context gate so mixed values with Apple context do not corrupt unrelated kebab identifiers elsewhere in the same field.

options.title: Use The Broader Sibling Design
options.body: Pause this PR and choose the larger hybrid/dictionary approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94256 if maintainers prefer fail-closed generic masking despite its current conflict state.

recommendation.title: Accept Context-Gated Generic Redaction
recommendation.body: After fixing the stale transcript test and adding live proof, merge this focused approach and accept that no-context generic app-password-shaped values may remain visible to preserve ordinary kebab identifiers.
